description: Agent Hub (Claude Code and Codex): PermissionRequest is forwarded to the hub daemon over a Unix socket and waits for the card's decision (no longer than ~2 min); SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/SessionEnd/Stop are async and only register sessions (Codex runs SessionEnd hooks synchronously for at most 3 s whatever the file says, hence its 3 s timeout). Daemon not running, session not interactive, timeout, 'decide in terminal' — the hook prints {} and the agent's own dialog works as if there were no hook. onFailure: block is not used.
